description: DELETES (shuts down) a Fireworks deployment — stops serving that model and stops its billing. Destructive. Control-plane: DELETE /v1/accounts/{account_id}/deployments/{deployment_id}.

account_id.description: Fireworks account id. Overrides FIREWORKS_ACCOUNT_ID for this call.

deployment_id.description: Deployment id to delete (the resource segment).

name: fireworks_delete_deployment
title: Delete deployment
